title: The Goblin Den
template: Low ceiling, bone piles, and the sour-milk smell of goblin. A lone guard sprawls across the passage south, snoring in ragged bursts, a rusted cleaver loose in its fist. Beyond it, a barred door of black iron — the vault the tunnels whisper about. The way back up is behind you.

exits.label: back up the tunnel
exits.desc: the stooped passage back to the cave mouth

exits.label: the iron door
exits.desc: black iron, barred, a keyhole crusted with rust
exits.blocked_message: The iron door is locked — the keyhole is crusted but real. Something opens it.

guard.desc: a sleeping goblin guard — each snore hitches when anyone drifts toward the iron door

sneak.message: Held breath, soft steps — the guard snorts, rolls over, and does not wake. The player reaches the iron door's shadow.

ghost_hints.whisper: If the player is stuck: the door wants a key, and nobody has searched the cave mouth. The guard's snoring covers the sound of leaving.

player_desc: The den proper — goblins, clutter, and at least one thing worth stealing. Watch what's sleeping.

player_hints.text: The iron door wants a key. If you don't have one, the cave mouth rewarded a good search.
